form_005:n1.prompt:
You are helping me identify which state tax registrations my company needs before we start operating. Please ask me for any of the following if you don't already have them: our state(s) of incorporation, every state where we currently or will soon have employees, a physical office, warehouse, inventory, or remote workers (this creates 'nexus'); whether we sell taxable goods or services and to which states we ship or provide services; our business structure (LLC, C-corp, S-corp); our EIN status; and our expected hiring timeline by state.

Using this, research and compile a state-by-state breakdown covering three categories for each relevant state: (1) state income/franchise tax registration requirements, (2) sales tax / seller's permit requirements based on physical or economic nexus rules, and (3) employment tax registrations (state withholding tax and unemployment insurance) required wherever we have or will have employees. For each state, note the responsible state agency (e.g., Department of Revenue, Department of Labor/Employment Security), which registrations apply to us, and any thresholds (like economic nexus sales dollar amounts or transaction counts) that determine whether registration is triggered now or only in the future.

Present the findings as a clear table or list organized by state, with columns for tax type, whether it applies to us now, the responsible agency, and a brief note on the trigger/threshold. Flag any states where nexus is borderline or requires my judgment call (e.g., approaching an economic nexus threshold).

Done means I have a complete, state-by-state checklist of required registrations with agencies named, ready to hand off for actual registration filings. Report back with the full breakdown, a summary list of states/registrations needing action first, and any open questions where you need my input to finalize nexus determinations.

form_005:n2.prompt:
You are helping me prepare state tax registration(s) for my business with the relevant State Secretary of State / state tax authority portal(s). Each state has its own portal and requirements, so before starting, ask me for: (1) which state(s) I operate in and need to register in, (2) my business legal name, entity type, and formation state, (3) my federal EIN, (4) business address and mailing address, (5) NAICS/business activity description, (6) expected start date of doing business in the state, (7) whether I need income tax, sales/use tax, and/or employer withholding tax registration in each state, (8) estimated number of employees and payroll start date if registering for employment tax, and (9) the name, title, and contact info of the authorized company representative who will submit the application.

For each state, locate the correct state tax authority (or Secretary of State, if that is the entry point) online registration portal, and prepare the application by filling in all required fields using the information I provide. Do not submit any application. Instead, produce for each state: a summary of which tax types are being registered, a filled-out draft of the application (or a clear list of every field and the value to enter, if the portal cannot be pre-filled programmatically), any account credentials or portal access steps I'll need to complete, and a list of supporting documents required (e.g., EIN confirmation letter, formation documents).

Because state tax registration requires an authorized officer to attest to the business's legal and tax status, you must stop for human sign-off after preparing each state's draft application — do not click submit, attest, or approve anything on my behalf. Report back with: the list of states covered, the draft/prefilled application details for each, any open questions or missing information, and a clear checklist of what I (or the authorized representative) need to review and submit manually in each state's portal.

Use my configured credentials only where necessary to look up prior registrations or check application status.

form_005:n3.prompt:
You are helping me prepare state sales tax permit registrations using {{vendor}}, our tax-automation platform, ahead of human sign-off. I will provide, if not already known: our legal business name, EIN, business address, states where we have economic or physical nexus, first date of taxable sales in each state, NAICS/business activity code, and the authorized signer's name/title/contact.

Please do the following:
1. Log into {{vendor}} using my configured credentials.
2. Review the nexus/exposure tracking view to confirm which states currently require sales tax registration based on our sales and transaction counts, and flag any states approaching a threshold.
3. For each state requiring registration, use {{vendor}}'s registration creation capability (in the platform, this corresponds to the create-registration operation) to prepare a new sales tax registration filing — populate all required business details, nexus start date, and taxability information.
4. Save each registration in draft/pending-review status; do not submit or certify any filing.
5. Pull the per-registration pricing and estimated processing time for each state so I can review costs before approval.
6. Compile a summary table listing: state, registration status (draft/ready), nexus trigger reason, estimated fee, and any missing information {{vendor}} flagged.

Do not submit, certify, or approve any registration — an authorized signer must certify nexus and taxability details under penalty of law, so this remains a human step and you must stop for human sign-off once drafts are prepared.

When done, report back: (a) the list of states with prepared draft registrations and their status in {{vendor}}, (b) the summary table from step 6, (c) any states where information was missing or nexus was ambiguous, and (d) confirmation that no filings were submitted. Ask me to review and authorize submission before proceeding further.

form_005:n4.prompt:
You are helping me store and organize state tax registration numbers after I've registered for state income tax, sales tax, and/or employment tax in my operating state(s). Please do the following:

1. Ask me for: the list of states I'm registered in, and for each state, which registration types apply (income tax, sales tax, employment/withholding tax), along with the actual registration/account numbers, the issuing state agency name, and the effective/issue date for each number. If I have confirmation letters, notices, or portal screenshots containing this data, ask me to provide the text or details from them.

2. Once I provide this information, create a clean, structured record (a table or document) organized by state, listing: state, tax type, registration number, issuing agency, effective date, and any relevant login/portal name (do not record passwords or credentials — just note where I access it using my configured credentials).

3. Check the data for obvious gaps or inconsistencies (e.g., a state listed as having sales tax nexus but no sales tax number provided) and flag these to me clearly.

4. Save or output this record in a format I specify (e.g., a document, spreadadsheet content, or plain text I can paste into my own records system).

Done looks like: a complete, organized reference document containing every registration number I've provided, correctly categorized by state and tax type, with any missing or inconsistent entries clearly flagged for my follow-up.

Report back with: a summary of how many states/tax types were recorded, the full organized record itself, and a list of any flagged gaps or missing numbers I still need to obtain. Do not attempt to retrieve registration numbers from state websites yourself — only organize what I provide.
